Welcome to Virginia Farm Animal Sanctuary (VFAS)  — a place of lifelong sanctuary for farm animals in need of a forever home.

Many of the animals here were once beloved pets whose families experienced life changes such as illness, loss, relocation, downsizing, or other circumstances beyond their control. When care needed a new place to continue, VFAS became that place.

Our mission is simple: provide lifelong sanctuary, compassionate care, and peace of mind for both animals and the people who love them.

Follow along for daily life at the sanctuary, animal stories, behind-the-scenes moments, educational content, tours, special events, and the frequent funny farm moment.

Home to donkeys, goats, sheep, pigs, llamas, poultry, and more, every resident here has a story — and every story matters.
